messages:
Avery: Quick micro-poll — I'm putting together a late-night 'micro list' of short documentaries (<=90min) + short books (<200 pages). Drop one doc + one short book that's stayed with you. I'll compile and share. No need to be recent. :sparkles:
Priya: Doc — 'Jiro Dreams of Sushi' (81m). Book — 'The Sense of an Ending' (Julian Barnes, ~150p). Tiny but stays with you.
Marco: Doc — not many fit 90m but 'The Last Draft' (57m) is a great writer doc. Book — 'The Slow Regard of Silent Things' (~160p) — weird and perfect for late-night.
Lina: 'Honeyland' (86m) + 'Stoner' (John Williams, 176p) — both haunt me in different ways.
Sasha: 'The King of Kong' is a favorite but ~93m so slightly over. Book — 'We Have Always Lived in the Castle' (~160p) — uncanny + cozy.
Evan: Love this. Doc pick: 'Born to Be' (87m). Book: 'Breakfast at Tiffany's' (Capote, ~100p) — short and sharp.
Avery: @Sasha noted on the 93m — I'll keep the list <=90 but will add a "near misses" section for favorites like that.
OpsBot: Poll created — react with :thumbsup: to keep, :eyes: for near-miss, :no_entry: to drop. Link: https://polls.example.com/1809753011
Priya: Voting — :thumbsup: for Honeyland + Stoner.
Marco: :eyes: for King of Kong (guilty).
Lina: quick plug — if anyone wants legit library PDFs/links I can share. No piracy, just interlibrary stuff.
Sasha: wildcard book: short essay collection 'The Empathy Exams' — essays are bite-sized, great for one-sitting reads.
Evan: Also thinking pairing each doc with a ~30min playlist. Anyone have low-fi / ambient recs?
Avery: Nice idea. I'll assemble doc + playlists + "near misses" and post in #random next week. If you want to be anonymous in the credits say so. Thanks everyone :heart:
